name: PSD Preview
description: Native Photoshop (.psd / .psb) preview: renders the flattened composite, reports document properties and exposes the layer tree.
author: Bowerbird Team
longDescription:
### Key Features
- **Composite rendering**: reproduces the merged image Photoshop stores inside the file, so what you see is what the designer flattened — no layer flattening needed on our side.
- **Layer tree in the inspector**: reads the layer groups and visibility flags, so you can tell whether the copy you are looking at is the currently-hidden variant.
- **Document properties**: pixel dimensions, color mode (RGB / CMYK / grayscale), bit depth, layer count and whether the document carries alpha transparency.
- **Thumbnail-first inspector**: uses the embedded thumbnail for the right-hand panel so browsing a folder of PSDs stays fast, then upgrades to the full composite once the file is parsed.
- **Zoom & pan**: percentage zoom with fit-to-window, driven by the host's zoom controls.
